correctness.rationale: The exact local identity sigma(q^a)=1+q+...+q^a makes nu_p(sigma(n)) additive over prime powers. The exponent-one proxy F_p(n)=sum_{q|n}nu_p(q+1) differs by a function with bounded mean absolute value. Mertens sums in the classes -1 modulo p^j give mean coefficient sum_j 1/phi(p^j)=p/(p-1)^2; the weighted second-moment sum is O_p(log log x), with high moduli controlled by a dyadic Brun–Titchmarsh bound, and Turan-Kubilius plus Chebyshev yields the claimed normal order.
